title: Other downloaded reports do not carry the joined Title - Description text
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
  • Require Tech Story (Settings, Work Orders tab) is off.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154720 Fleet) has a contact person and an asset, {Asset-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154720 Truck).
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open for {Customer-A} and {Asset-A} at {Location-A}, not invoiced.
  • {Work-order-1} has a labor line {Line-1} with Title (for example "ZZAUTOTEST-WW-20 Pump"), Description (for example "seal leak") and no tech story.
  • {Work-order-1} has been completed and invoiced as invoice {Invoice-A} (for example 10234), dated {Invoice-date-A} (for example 13 Oct 2026).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports page and click Export Reports (if it is not there, open it from Administration).
  2. Download every report listed other than Customer Invoice, each for a date range covering {Invoice-date-A}.
  3. In each downloaded file, search for {Line-1}'s title, a space, a hyphen, a space and its description (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-20 Pump - seal leak).
  4. Download the Customer Invoice report for the same date range.
  5. Search that file for the same text.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: no other file contains the joined text. A file may show the title or the description on its own; that is fine.
  • Step 3: reports that cannot be downloaded from Export Reports are not covered by this case; write "not checked by hand" for them in the result comment.
  • Step 5: the Customer Invoice file contains the joined text, in the ItemDescription cell of {Line-1}'s row.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S3-R11, read 13 Oct 2026; no design board covers other reports; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), FR-010; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R11: “No other report or export reads this line text. Changing it changes these two routes and nothing else.”
  • Tech plan FR-010: “One builder produces the text for both the live QuickBooks Online sync and the downloadable Customer Invoice report; nothing else reads it (S3-R4, S3-R11).”
